units.source_text: 谁知女人一脸为难的表情，紧闭着嘴唇一声不吭。

en.t: Unexpectedly, the woman looked troubled and kept her lips tightly closed, saying nothing at all.

units.source_text: 简直就像瞧见丢了糖果死缠硬磨的孩子，一副不耐烦的样子。

en.t: She looked downright impatient, as if she were watching a child pestering someone endlessly after losing a piece of candy.
